evidence.detail: preaggregate_season_count() does COUNT(*) WHERE archetype_id IS NOT NULL with no match-count filter — zero-match decks are included in the playability denominator
deck_cache table has wins, draws, losses columns — a filter of wins+losses+draws>0 is technically available
Author's own comment says 'may lead to some far-reaching changes like every table having num matches not num decks' — explicitly anticipates broad scope beyond a one-line filter

triage.notes: The minimum fix (add wins+losses+draws>0 JOIN to deck_cache in 6+ preaggregate_* functions) touches >150 lines across playability.py and requires a decision on the broader question of whether to switch from deck-count to match-count denominators throughout. Classify as needs-work pending that architectural choice.
